title: feat: rename packages
body:
**Summary**

This PR removes the following packages from the monorepo:
- react-instantsearch
- react-instantsearch-dom
- react-instantsearch-dom-maps
- react-instantsearch-native

It then renames the packages in this fashion:
- react-instantsearch-hooks-web → react-instantsearch
- react-instantsearch-hooks → react-instantsearch-core
- react-instantsearch-hooks-router-nextjs → react-instantsearch-router-nextjs
- react-instantsearch-hooks-server → all files included in react-instantsearch-core/server

Misc:
- react examples are replaced with those from react-hooks
- configuration and ci is updated


FX-2338

> **Note**  
> It will probably be easier to review commit by commit, and ignore the first one ("move packages") as it just shuffles around a bunch of files.
